tts: This program repeats two lines, once for each day of the course, and keeps a running total.
The comment says what the program does.
total starts at zero, before the loop.
range one to four gives one, two and three. The loop starts, and day is one.
Two tablets are added to total, so total is two.
print shows day one.
The block is finished, so Python goes back to the top of the loop. day becomes two.
total becomes four, and print shows day two.
Once more for day three. total becomes six.
range has no numbers left, so the loop ends. The last line is not indented, so it runs once, and shows the total.
